re.service: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148)

title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Clearwater Neurology Group under your health plan for services provided on June 4, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.

Reason for denial: The MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast is not medically necessary. Our clinical guideline CAL-NEU-347 requires documentation of conservative treatment before this service, and the records submitted do not show it. Reason code: CO-50.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $2,824.56 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $2,824.56.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Calloway Health Network, Appeals Unit, PO Box 65579, Oakland, CA 94612. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-6567.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
